programme.title: Pappan priyappetta Pappan
programme.desc: Pappan, a singer, is given another chance to live by Lord Yama after his death. However, his life takes an interesting turn when the deity gives him the power to enter the bodies of other dead people.

programme.title: Arjunan Pillayum Anchu Makkalum
programme.desc: A father realises his mistake after his son, whom he loves dearly, kicks him out of the house. At the time, his daughters decide to help him out despite being neglected.

programme.title: Janmandharam
programme.desc: Four bachelors bravely fight against the injustice meted out towards the villagers. However, they land in trouble when they go up against the evil landlord, Panikkar.

programme.title: Mayaponman
programme.desc: Prasanth is a mechanic and is best friends with Freddy. One day, they come across a girl, whose extended family is chasing her for her inherited wealth, and try to save her.

programme.title: Achayans
programme.desc: When a family of four sets out on a road trip, they are accompanied by two girls on their way. However, things take an unexpected turn when one of the girls is found dead.

programme.title: Soorya Gayathri
programme.desc: Dr Balasubrahmaniam, a widower, loses his only son to ragging. Overcome by grief, he sets out to avenge his son's death and seek justice for his loss.

programme.title: Ardhanaari
programme.desc: Manjula, a transgender woman in Kerala, faces daily challenges in a conservative society. Her journey of self-acceptance and resilience unfolds against evolving social norms.

programme.title: Vida Parayum Mumbe
programme.desc: Xavier, a stenographer, finds himself terminated after his boss learns that he lied to him for a leave. However, when the boss learns that Xavier is a cancer patient, he regrets his decision.

programme.title: Rathinirvedam
programme.desc: Pappu falls in love with Rathi, who is older than him. However, things take a turn for the worse when a snake bites Rathi, and he is unable to ask for help due to their secret relationship.

programme.title: Made in U.S.A.
programme.desc: Roby, a young man, migrates to Las Vegas in hopes of earning a livelihood and starts working at a casino. Things take a turn when he loses his friend's money and struggles with mental health issues.

programme.title: Avittam Thirunaal Aarogya Sriman
programme.desc: An old man who depends on his family is not particularly liked due to his irksome habits. It all changes when the family learns that he owns a large rubber estate.

programme.title: Alexander the Great
programme.desc: Prathapa Verma, in his will, has bequeathed all his property to his illegitimate son, Alexander. His legitimate son and other relatives struggle to get the power of attorney by killing Alexander.

programme.title: Kadha Thudarunnu
programme.desc: Vidyalakshmi struggles to lead a normal life with her daughter after the sudden death of her husband. However, her world transforms after meeting Preman, an auto-rickshaw driver.

programme.title: Bhargavacharitham Moonam Khandam
programme.desc: Bhargavan, a criminal suffering from panic attacks that hold him back from attacking people, goes to a psychiatrist for treatment.

programme.title: Uppukandam Brothers
programme.desc: Ananthan Pilla murders Chacko for being an informer of his illicit business. When the police refuse to file a complaint, Chacko's son approaches a prominent family known as the Uppukandam Brothers.

programme.title: Sooryakireedam
programme.desc: Four friends end up staying in an ancestral house which is haunted by the spirit of Urmila. By the time they realise the truth about the house, things start getting worse.

programme.title: Sasneham Sumithra
programme.desc: After the mysterious death of his first wife, Balan decides to marry another woman. However, things take a suspicious turn when her body is discovered in his house.

programme.title: Peterscott
programme.desc: A man hands over a large sum of money to two ladies, assuming they are sent to him by his employer. However, when he realises that he has been cheated, he sets out to look for them.

programme.title: Boyy Friennd
programme.desc: Ramesh's mother files a case against the home minister for molesting her. After a few days, the minister is found dead and people suspect Ramesh of murdering him.

programme.title: Kinnari Puzhayoram
programme.desc: A father chooses the richer of two brothers as a suitor for his daughter. Filled with anger, the spurned brother acts like a holy man, which changes all their lives unexpectedly.

programme.title: Oridathoru Postman
programme.desc: Raghu, a responsible youth, faces the wrath of the villagers as he is the son of a lazy postman. However, Raghu's life takes a turn when he encounters Yasin Mubarak, a notorious man.

programme.title: Orkkapurathu
programme.desc: Brokers, Freddy and Nicholas, try various ways to make money to repossess their boat from a businessman. However, they get into trouble when they resort to illegal ways to earn money.

programme.title: Prajapathi
programme.desc: Narayanan, who gets convicted for killing his father, returns from prison to his village and works selflessly for its people. However, his vengeful relatives create obstacles for him.

programme.title: Kuyiline Thedi
programme.desc: Shyam goes to a village to look for his uncle and get a job. There, he falls in love with a girl but faces problems when a landlord named Thampurankutty, a ruthless man, tries to marry her.

programme.title: Rain Rain Come Again
programme.desc: A fierce college rivalry turns deadly when one group embrace Satanism, unleashing terror by killing their rivals one by one.

programme.title: Journalist
programme.desc: Ranjini Menon, an investigative journalist in a newspaper, runs into trouble after reporting the atrocities of Sharma, a millionaire and an industrialist.

programme.title: Aakasam
programme.desc: Manoharan leads a peaceful life with his family. However, fear engulfs him when he realises that a sketch of a wanted terrorist resembles him.

programme.title: Achammakuttiyude Achayan
programme.desc: Achamma and her husband lead a peaceful life abroad. However, their life takes a turn when Achamma returns to her native place and encounters her ex-husband, John.

programme.title: Kasargod Khader Bhai
programme.desc: Kasargode Khadarbhai and his son, Kasimbhai, attempt to take revenge on a group of mimicry artists for sending Khadarbhai to prison.

programme.title: August 15
programme.desc: When V G Sadanand, the CM of Kerala, is poisoned on 15th August, the case goes to DSP Perumal. However, he soon realises that he is hunting a cunning criminal who leaves no evidence.

programme.title: Adiyozhukkukal
programme.desc: After Karunan comes out of jail, he discovers that his girlfriend has married Kumaran, the man who sent him to prison. Karunan decides to work hard and take revenge against Kumaran.

programme.title: Aniyan Bava Chetan Bava
programme.desc: An intense rivalry ensues between two brothers after their daughters fall in love with their driver. However, things take a drastic turn after their rivalry becomes a matter of their family prestige.

programme.title: Kottayam Kunjachan
programme.desc: Kottayam Kunjachan, a small-time thug, gets out of jail after serving a term of seven years for killing a person. Once out, he tries to lead a good life but gets embroiled in a family feud.

programme.title: Out of Syllabus
programme.desc: When village boy Gopikrishnan goes to study in a city college, he is bullied by his classmates. Namitha supports him through his difficult phase and they develop a close bond.

programme.title: Simon Peter Ninakku Vendi
programme.desc: Smuggler Simon Peter falls in love with Alice. However, he becomes the target of a gangster when he tries to cease the illegal activities carried out in the neighbourhood.

programme.title: Sadgamaya
programme.desc: Ravi Varman, a psychiatrist, treats only one patient at a time and that too in isolation. When he learns that his former patient Yamuna is getting married, he decides to meet her.
